desc: NASA commissioned the UAP Independent Study Team on 24 May 2022, with David Spergel as chair and Daniel Evans as designated federal official. Its sixteen members were Spergel, Anamaria Berea (George Mason), Federica Bianco (Delaware), Paula Bontempi, Reggie Brothers (AE Industrial Partners), Jen Buss (Potomac Institute for Policy Studies), Nadia Drake, Mike Gold (Redwire), David Grinspoon, Scott Kelly, Matt Mountain, Warren Randolph (FAA), Walter Scott (Maxar), Joshua Semeter (Boston University), Karlin Toner (FAA) and Shelley Wright (UC San Diego). The team began work on 24 October 2022, held a single public meeting on 31 May 2023, and delivered its report on 14 September 2023, dissolving the same day; NASA announced a Director of UAP Research at the same time. Its conclusions were that no evidence of extraterrestrial origin was found, that poor-quality and limited data is the binding constraint, and that NASA should apply a rigorous evidence-based approach incorporating artificial intelligence and citizen observation. For this board, the panel is best read as a measurement of access rather than of evidence: sixteen serious scientists, examining only unclassified material, concluding that unclassified material is insufficient. The panel was never given the thing the argument is about.
